entries.高增长科技创业；阶段以 Seed 为主。: High-growth technology startups; primarily at the Seed stage.
entries.高增长科技创业；阶段以 Seed–growth 为主。: High-growth technology startups; primarily at the Seed–growth stage.
entries.高增长科技创业；阶段以 Student / pre-founder 为主。: High-growth technology startups; primarily at the Student / pre-founder stage.
entries.高增长科技创业；阶段以 Student / recent-grad founde: High-growth technology startups; primarily at the Student / recent-grad founders stage.
entries.高增长科技创业；阶段以 Very early 为主。: High-growth technology startups; primarily at the Very early stage.
entries.高增长科技创业；阶段以 已创业公司创始人 / CEO 为主。: High-growth technology startups; primarily at the Existing startup founders / CEOs stage.
entries.$5M+ revenue 或 funds raised；计划在 NYC 设立业务: At least $5M in revenue or funding raised; currently operating outside the US; demonstrated traction for an AI product or service; plans to establish NYC operations and grow to more than five team members within 24 months.
entries.0→1 执行、速度、earned secret、互补团队、早期 prototyp: Strong zero-to-one execution, speed, a distinctive insight, complementary founders and early prototypes or metrics.
entries.10–15分钟 pitch materials；团队、技术、market、竞争、: A 10–15 minute pitch covering the team, technology, market, competition and technical development plan, followed by due diligence.
entries.12个月；提供 NYC 1年 dedicated coworking（每家公司最: 12 months, including one year of dedicated NYC coworking for up to two people per company. Not a traditional residency, but establishing a NYC presence is encouraged.
entries.12周，current Base Camp material明确 Fully r: 12 weeks; current Base Camp materials describe a fully remote program.
entries.12周，约25小时/周。官网项目页写 In person, Montreal；F: 12 weeks at approximately 25 hours per week. The program page specifies Montreal in person; the FAQ describes hybrid workshops, but strongly recommends attendance. International applicants must participate in Montreal for 12 weeks.
entries.12周；以 British Columbia 为核心，包含加拿大 ecosyst: 12 weeks centered on British Columbia and Canadian customer access. Full relocation is not explicitly required, but on-site pilots and partner engagement are important.
entries.15–20分钟在线申请；后续 rolling review / intervie: A 15–20 minute online application, followed by rolling review and interviews.
entries.19期 2026-06-26 截止；20期计划 2027-05 启动报名: Cohort 19 closed June 26, 2026; cohort 20 applications are planned to open in May 2027.
entries.1页 blinded resume、Technical Vision、Techn: A one-page anonymized resume, Technical Vision, Technical Reality and other official materials within the stated limits.
entries.2008年至今；截至2025年底累计1429名学员。更像高质量 founder: Operating since 2008, with 1,429 participants through the end of 2025. A founder development program rather than a typical equity accelerator.
entries.2019年至今连续举办；计划2026筛选约50–60项目。历史30+项目获市场化: Running annually since 2019; plans to select approximately 50–60 projects in 2026. More than 30 past projects have received market-based investment.
entries.2026 全国项目招募；具体截止日以申请页为准: China-wide recruitment for 2026; consult the application page for deadlines.
entries.2026 已有 3 天具身智能产业营在苏州工业园区举办；MARS Space 持: A three-day embodied AI camp took place in Suzhou Industrial Park in 2026. MARS Space continues industry camps and financing and supply-chain events. Cohort five is recruiting; the full schedule is not published.
entries.2026 火星具身智能产业营持续招募；MARS Space 已运行: Recruitment continues for the 2026 MARS embodied AI camp; MARS Space is operating.
entries.2026秋季常规申请已截止；延期申请仍开放: Regular Fall 2026 applications have closed; late applications remain open.
entries.22岁及以下；没有大学学位；若仍在校，入选必须退学；至少对具体愿景已有实质进展。: Age 22 or younger, without a university degree. Selected students must leave university and demonstrate meaningful progress toward a specific vision.
entries.2–3支优胜团队评选；种子资金需进一步满足条件/决策: Two or three winning teams are selected; seed funding requires further eligibility checks and a separate decision.
entries.2年项目。Berkeley/Boston/NY/Houston 有所在地要求；A: Two years. Berkeley, Boston, New York and Houston tracks have location requirements. The Anywhere track also requires quarterly in-person US events.
entries.3个月创业营；团队无需常驻北京: Three-month founder camp; teams do not need to live in Beijing.
entries.4–6个月加速: Four to six months of acceleration.
entries.4个月 virtual accelerator；cofounder/CEO/se: Four-month virtual accelerator. A cofounder, CEO or senior leader must participate and attend the October Showcase and Finals.
entries.6个月；London & Global。官方未写必须全程常驻伦敦，实际为全球项目: Six months, London and global. Full-time London residency is not explicitly required; key events and corporate meetings may be in person.
entries.7% equity；已有融资项目可按上一轮估值同步投资: 7% equity; companies that have already raised funding may receive investment at their previous-round valuation.
entries.AI infra / apps / cyber / healthcare / c: AI infrastructure and applications, cybersecurity, healthcare, consumer, robotics and hardware. Strong technical teams, real usage and large market potential.
entries.AI startup，需能利用 Anthropic/Claude 生态产生差异化: AI startups with differentiated value from the Anthropic/Claude ecosystem; pre-seed through Series A may qualify.
entries.AI、半导体、先进制造、新能源、生物医药等硬科技: AI, semiconductors, advanced manufacturing, new energy, biomedicine and other deep technologies.
entries.AI、大模型/Agent、机器人、B2B、量子、生物科技、商业航天、出海等: AI, large models and agents, robotics, B2B, quantum technology, biotech, commercial space and international expansion.
entries.AI、新能源、智能制造及跨境创新: AI, new energy, intelligent manufacturing and cross-border innovation.
entries.Arc Intensive 为集中线下活动；具体每期地点/日期以当期 open: Arc Intensive consists of concentrated in-person activities. Locations and dates depend on the current open call.
entries.Arc open call；若已有 Sequoia network warm i: Apply through the Arc open call; a warm introduction through the Sequoia network may run in parallel.
entries.B2B 早期 founder 强推荐: Strong fit for early B2B founders.
entries.Berkeley ecosystem program；具体每期线下节奏以申请页为: A Berkeley ecosystem program; check the current application page for in-person arrangements.
entries.Bootcamp 8周必须在 SF / NYC / Bangalore 其中一个: The eight-week bootcamp requires working from an SF, NYC or Bangalore office. Subsequent residency arrangements depend on company needs.
entries.Consumer、硬件、biotech/medtech、累计融资≥US$2M、无: Consumer, hardware or biotech/medtech companies; companies with at least $2M raised; founders unable to attend the full four-day Sonoma retreat.
entries.Deeptech / medtech / edtech，技术有显著创新或可专利；: Deeptech, medtech and edtech founders with significant or patentable innovation who can participate intensively in Montreal for 12 weeks.
entries.Early founder building a new B2B SaaS co: Early founders building a new B2B SaaS company. Global applications accepted; less than $2M raised; full four-day Sonoma attendance required.
entries.Early- to mid-stage medical device, diag: Early to mid-stage medical device, diagnostics or digital health companies based in, or entering, APAC. Applicants may apply to both US and APAC programs but can join only one per year.
entries.Early-stage Web3 team；项目需符合当期 Base Camp: Early-stage Web3 teams matching the current Base Camp thesis, such as DeAI, DeFi, RWA or DePIN.
entries.Early-stage maritime/logistics startup；技: Early-stage maritime or logistics startups with technology addressing a shipping or logistics use case.
entries.Early-stage tech startup，跨行业、全球 founder；: Early-stage technology startups from any industry or country. Selected teams attend the four-month Silicon Valley Flagship program and complete investment due diligence with 500 Global.
entries.Enterprise/customer references；US expans: Enterprise customer references, a US expansion plan, a clear hiring plan and a strong funding or revenue history.
entries.Fintech，尤其 wealth management、corporate/i: Fintech teams seeking Italian or European financial customers, especially in wealth management, banking, lending, insurance, legal technology, compliance, audit or risk.
entries.Foundshore 中国区最高优先级之一。每年2期；先投资后加速；Demo D: A high-priority China program in the source assessment. Two cohorts per year, investment before acceleration and an investor-focused Demo Day.
entries.Foundshore 评价：life-science tools 项目强推荐；不: Strong fit for life-science tools; distinct from a therapeutics accelerator.
entries.Foundshore 评价：仅推荐真正 Web3/crypto-native 团: Best suited to Web3-native teams. AI projects need a clear connection to decentralized AI, the agentic web or crypto infrastructure.
entries.Foundshore 评价：全球 founder 进入 Silicon Vall: A valuable Silicon Valley entry route for international founders. Terms are explicit, although 6% equity may be costly for companies with higher valuations or previous funding.
entries.Foundshore 评价：对真正 deeptech/medtech found: Strong fit for deeptech and medtech. Montreal attendance and a predominantly French workshop environment are material considerations; this is not a remote global program.
entries.Foundshore 评价：应逐步用 SOSV SF / SOSV NY 替代旧: Use SOSV SF and SOSV NY for the current offering. The IndieBio entry is retained for historical reference.
entries.Foundshore 评价：欧洲 fintech/enterprise dist: Strong European fintech and enterprise distribution value; not a general-purpose program for non-fintech companies.
entries.Foundshore 评价：这是 youth-maker grant，不应和标准: A youth-maker grant rather than a standard accelerator. Applicants and projects outside North America should not expect grant funding.
entries.Foundshore 评价：适合已经在加拿大落地的 B2B SaaS；不适合把它: Best for B2B SaaS companies already based in Canada, rather than as an initial Canadian entry route for overseas founders.
entries.Foundshore 评价：适合希望得到长期深度运营支持、而非短期 Demo D: Best for pre-seed and seed companies seeking sustained operational support. Consumer companies without clear product-market fit, or teams seeking funding only, are less suitable.
entries.Foundshore 评价：适合想进入 APAC 的全球 medtech；如果目: Strong fit for global medtech entering APAC. For a US-only strategy, consider MTI US or VANTAGE.
entries.Foundshore 评价：适合有明确保险/金融 enterprise use: Best for insurance and financial enterprise use cases. The main value is Aviva access and Founders Factory operational support, beyond the cash investment.
entries.Foundshore 评价：适合硬件/AI/automation/green s: Best for hardware, AI, automation or green shipping with clear deployment opportunities. Value comes from real commercial use cases.
entries.Foundshore 评价：非常垂直，适合有真实 maritime hardwa: A specialist program for maritime hardware and software deployments; a weaker fit for general climate SaaS.
entries.Foundshore 评价：非常适合极早期 technical builder: Best for very early technical builders, students and side-project founders. The network and founder development matter more than the $10K; not a systematic fundraising accelerator for mature companies.
entries.Foundshore：Primary Value=founder/talent: Primarily a founder and talent network. FDE, design, growth, talent and new-media fellowships are operator development programs, not capital programs.
entries.Foundshore：属于 pre-founder talent/fellows: A pre-founder fellowship rather than a startup accelerator, especially relevant to students turning frontier research into companies.
entries.Foundshore：资本=0，但 PMF/GTM/network value: No investment, but potentially substantial product-market fit, go-to-market and network value.
entries.Foundshore：这是典型的“不给钱但对合适公司价值极高”的项目；核心价值是: A US market-entry program with customer, talent, immigration guidance and Lightspeed access; it does not guarantee funding.
entries.Foundshore：高信号但 eligibility 极窄；不要推荐给普通国际: A focused opportunity for AI builders with a qualifying Berkeley affiliation, not a broadly eligible international-founder program.
entries.Frontier-tech 本科生强推荐: Strong fit for undergraduate frontier-technology builders.
entries.Global Founders Program 可帮助处理 visa / rel: The Global Founders Program can help navigate visas and relocation; this does not constitute legal visa sponsorship.
entries.Global Founders Program；具体签证/入境仍需个案确认。: Global Founders Program; visa and entry arrangements require individual confirmation.
entries.Global partnership；官方重点是 pilots/deployme: A global partnership focused on pilots and deployment rather than a fixed residency. On-site participation depends on the corporate pilot.
entries.Global-from-day-one 思维；已有 MVP / 初始 tract: A global outlook, an MVP or initial traction, a scalable market and the ability to iterate on product, growth and fundraising over four months.
entries.HAX 为 in-person 硬科技项目；当前申请地点包括 Newark, N: HAX is an in-person hard-tech program. Current locations include Newark, NJ and Princeton Plasma Forge; historical and some other programs involve Shenzhen.
entries.High school / college / dropout 的年轻 make: Young, self-directed makers in high school, college or outside formal education, working in science, technology, mathematics, arts, robotics or energy. Incorporation is not required.
entries.Hybrid。可在澳洲/新西兰参加；3个线下周（kickoff、mid-prog: Hybrid participation from Australia or New Zealand, with three in-person weeks for kickoff, midpoint and Demo Day; the remainder is remote.
entries.IndieBio legacy program 已纳入 SOSV SF / SO: The legacy IndieBio program is now part of SOSV SF and SOSV NY. Residency and laboratory participation depend on location; in-person engagement is central.
entries.Life science tools / molecular diagnosti: Life-science tools or molecular diagnostics startups, preferably before Series B or a major strategic partnership. Incorporation is required before the accelerator begins, but not at application.
entries.MedTech Innovator application account；公司: A MedTech Innovator account and company, product, clinical, regulatory, commercialization and funding information.
entries.MedTech Innovator core application；后续 pi: The core MedTech Innovator application, followed by pitch events and due diligence.
entries.Medical device / diagnostics / digital h: Early to mid-stage medical device, diagnostics or digital health companies seeking APAC market entry.
entries.Menlo 官网明确可通过各 Partner bio 上公开邮箱联系，或直接在线: Apply online or contact a Menlo partner through the public email address on their official biography.
entries.No Guaranteed Program Capital; separate: No guaranteed program capital; separate investment through the Cyzone angel fund.
entries.OceanTech / maritime / blue economy star: Ocean, maritime or blue-economy startups seeking Canadian pilots, ports, shipping partners and commercialization opportunities.
entries.Open call application；通常需要公司/团队/市场/tract: Open-call application, generally covering the company, team, market, traction and funding.
entries.PearX online application；公司/团队/产品/tracti: PearX online application covering the company, team, product and traction, followed by selection.
entries.Pre-idea/pre-seed；无 traction；非 AI；已经主要在美: Pre-idea or pre-seed teams without traction; non-AI companies; companies already operating mainly in the US; teams not planning to build an NYC team within 24 months.
entries.Pre-seed/seed 高增长公司；需符合 Sequoia 的 ventur: High-growth pre-seed and seed companies meeting Sequoia's venture-scale investment criteria. Few specific thresholds are published.
entries.Pre-seed–Series A fintech，尤其保险、财富管理、prop: Pre-seed to Series A fintech companies, particularly insurance, wealth, property, asset management, cybersecurity and AI, seeking financial-institution pilots or distribution.
entries.Pre-seed–Series A fintech；与 Aviva / Foun: Pre-seed to Series A fintech matching Aviva and Founders Factory investment themes. Open to London and global founders.
entries.Residency / bootcamp 形式，通常要求在 SF 深度参与；最长: Residency or bootcamp, generally requiring substantial SF participation, for up to approximately six months.
entries.Residency 申请；当前官网建议 pre-seed/seed fundin: Residency application; contact the team about pre-seed or seed funding. Warm introductions are preferred.
entries.SOSV application portal；可同时申请 HAX / Indi: SOSV application portal; applicants may apply to programs such as HAX and IndieBio.
entries.SOSV 表示接受国际团队，入选后可协助 legal/immigration；为: SOSV accepts international teams and can assist with legal and immigration matters after selection. A US company structure is generally recommended for fundraising.
entries.SPC 不直接 sponsor visa，可讨论个案。: SPC does not directly sponsor visas; individual circumstances may be discussed.
entries.Separate TusStar Ventures / 壹计划 selectio: Separate selection by TusStar Ventures or the One Plan initiative.
entries.Stanford 可按 academic visa 路径办理，但不 sponso: Stanford may use an academic visa pathway, but does not sponsor H-1B visas. Current policy may restrict some nationalities.
entries.Team/product/market/token or protocol de: Team, product, market, token or protocol design, traction and fundraising information; apply to the relevant Base Camp.
entries.Techstars 标准申请：founder profile、公司、demo v: Techstars application: founder profile, company information, demo video, pitch deck, team video, traction, revenue and funding.
entries.Techstars 标准申请：profile、公司、demo video、dec: Techstars application: profile, company information, demo video, deck, team video, traction, revenue, funding and go-to-market strategy.
entries.UC Berkeley 当前学生或毕业不超过3年的校友；AI technical: Current UC Berkeley students or alumni who graduated within three years, building AI at inception. Early cash, compute, legal and SkyDeck support may suit teams without substantial traction.
entries.Undergraduate builder；无需 incorporation；围: Undergraduate builders independently experimenting with frontier technology; incorporation is not required.
entries.bio/chemistry/materials/energy/food/AI/h: Biology, chemistry, materials, energy, food, AI and healthcare, with defensible technology, measurable milestones and strong science or engineering teams.
entries.deep technical expert + leader-ready；技术有: Deep technical expertise, leadership readiness, a scalable technology, a clear entry market and positive hard-tech impact.
entries.early-stage startup；入选后创始人需对创业项目 full ex: Early-stage startups. Accepted founders must work exclusively on the startup, without other employment or study. Techstars invests after incorporation, ownership, IP and bank-account checks.
entries.early–mid-stage medical device、diagnosti: Early to mid-stage medical device, diagnostics, digital health or health IT companies, potentially through Series C, ideally with a prototype or proof of concept and adequate runway.
entries.funding level、raised amount、traction、ind: Funding needs, capital raised, traction, industry, business model, relocation plans, pitch deck and a recommended one-minute video.
entries.hardware/physical technology；创始人需全职在 SF: Hardware or physical technology. Founders must participate full-time in SF; solo and international founders may apply, subject to lawful entry.
entries.healthtech 行业/研究经验、leadership、problem so: Healthtech or research experience, leadership, problem solving, creativity, teamwork and communication.
entries.international/immigrant founder；最佳候选为 po: International or immigrant founders, ideally with a post-seed technology company, team, MVP, traction and home-market funding, preparing a VC round.
entries.pre-seed deep tech；需能展示具有变革潜力的技术/产品。: Pre-seed deeptech with demonstrably transformative technology or products.
entries.pre-seed health/deeptech，尤其 therapeutics: Pre-seed health and deeptech, especially therapeutics, engineered biology and healthcare, with an appropriate research, regulatory and commercialization pathway.
entries.pre-seed/seed、AI/health/deeptech/media/e: Pre-seed and seed companies in AI, health, deeptech, media and engineering, with resilient founders, clarity, traction and commitment.
entries.pre-seed；idea stage 到已有 early traction 均: Pre-seed companies from idea to early traction. All teams must relocate to the SF Bay Area for 12 weeks.
entries.prior startup wins、deep technical expert: An advantage such as previous startup success, deep technical expertise, unique market insight or an influential network.
entries.prototype + proof of concept；足够 runway 执: A prototype or proof of concept, sufficient runway for milestones and a senior founder or CEO available throughout the program.
entries.prototype / clinical or technical valida: Prototype or clinical validation, a regulatory pathway, an APAC commercialization thesis and a senior leader available for the program and finals.
entries.written application + 90秒视频；随后约1小时 remot: Written application and a 90-second video, followed by an approximately one-hour remote interview.
entries.一份团队申请即可；说明项目/side project、创始人背景和你正在 bui: One application per team covering the project or side project, founder backgrounds and current work. Incorporation is not required.
entries.一年专项加速 + 产业验证: One year of focused acceleration and industrial validation.
entries.一年加速；含清华 x-lab 导师/场地/季度评审及壳牌场景合作，需能参加约定线: One year of acceleration with Tsinghua x-lab mentors, facilities, quarterly reviews and Shell collaboration. Participation in agreed project and in-person activities is required.
entries.Maritime / logistics startup，需要 CMA CGM: Maritime and logistics startups seeking CMA CGM pilots, first customers, commercial deployment and international expansion.
entries.不以 venture-scale 为目标、创始团队无法全职投入、或仅希望获得短期: Projects without venture-scale ambitions, founders unable to commit full-time, or teams seeking short-term exposure only.
entries.不应作为 international→Canada 的无门槛项目推荐；需先满足: Requires a Canadian-based company; not an unrestricted international-to-Canada entry program.
entries.不是 US-entry 项目；按 cohort 线下安排确认。: Not a US market-entry program; confirm cohort-specific attendance arrangements.
entries.不是传统 accelerator，无统一 on-site 要求；Menlo 提供: Not a traditional accelerator and no standard attendance requirement. Menlo offers fractional workspace in SF and Menlo Park, plus founder events.
entries.不要求常住北京；但录取创始人及主要成员需在9–12月参加为期3个月创业营，并按安: Beijing residency is not required. Selected founders and key team members must participate in the three-month September–December camp and scheduled in-person activities.
entries.不要求搬到 Los Angeles。Mucker 官方明确可 remote 参与: Relocation to Los Angeles is not required. Mucker explicitly permits remote participation; engagement averages approximately 12 months and can range from three to 24 months.
entries.不要求特定所在地。若选择参加 SF/NYC 线下部分，需自行具备合法入境资格；官: No required home location. Participants choosing SF or NYC activities need lawful entry; visa sponsorship is not published.
entries.不适用/中国项目。: Not applicable to this China-based program.
entries.不需要搬去 SF；全球均可。: No SF relocation required; participation is global.
entries.不需长期 relocation；参加 Showcase/Finals 时需自行满: Long-term relocation is not required; participants must meet entry requirements for the Showcase and Finals.
entries.与 ocean/maritime 无关；还没有可测试产品；只想融资、不需要 pi: Teams unrelated to ocean or maritime sectors, without a testable product, or seeking funding without pilots or market entry.
entries.与海运/物流无直接场景；还没有可以 pilot 的产品；只需要课堂式 accel: Teams without a shipping or logistics use case or a pilot-ready product, or seeking classroom instruction only.
entries.两次 all-expenses-covered retreat：NY kicko: Two fully covered retreats: a New York kickoff and September Fellows Summit. Other mentorship arrangements are flexible.
entries.个人申请；无需公司或团队，但要证明 meaningful progress。: Individual application; no company or team required, but meaningful progress must be demonstrated.
entries.个人申请；适合 healthcare/engineering/CS/design: Individual application for healthcare, engineering, computing, design or business backgrounds. Requires lawful US work through an academic visa, English proficiency and three recommendations.
entries.中国境内活动，国际创始人需自行解决入境/居留。: Activities take place in China; international founders must arrange lawful entry and residence.
entries.主体 remote-friendly/virtual；但 accepted co: Primarily remote or virtual. Each accepted company must send a cofounder, CEO or executive to the June Innovator Summit and October Showcase and Finals.
entries.主体 virtual；包含 Asia-based finals / showca: Primarily virtual, with in-person APAC finals or showcase events.
entries.主体 virtual；可能有强制线下活动，需查看当期安排。: Primarily virtual; check the current schedule for mandatory in-person events.
entries.主要 virtual。最后一天在 San Francisco 或 New Yor: Primarily virtual, with the final day in SF or NYC. Many fellows attend the full week locally, but this is not required.
entries.主要中国全国招募；非清华背景可。: Primarily China-wide recruitment; Tsinghua affiliation is not required.
entries.主要服务 Southeast Asia founder/startup；idea: Primarily Southeast Asian founders and startups. Idea-stage applications are accepted without existing traction.
entries.主要面向中国；国际团队需单独确认: Primarily China-focused; international teams should confirm eligibility individually.
entries.产业营 + 创始人社区 + 产业/资本连接: Industry camp, founder community and industry and capital connections.
entries.仅2–3支优胜团队；清华导师 + Shell 全球专家 + 真实产业场景，适合能: Two or three winning teams, supported by Tsinghua mentors, Shell experts and industrial use cases; focused on energy and deeptech.
entries.仍在校的 student founder；从 idea 还未定型到准备第一轮 e: Current student founders, from early ideas through preparation for a first equity round, seeking GC investors and a student founder network.
entries.以 campus community、events 和投资关系为主；无公开全程: Campus community, events and investment relationships; no full-time residency requirement published.
entries.以个人/创始人身份满足项目人群要求: Applicants must meet the program's individual or founder eligibility criteria.
entries.以北京为主要上课城市，部分课程外地举行。: Classes are mainly in Beijing, with some courses in other cities.
entries.优胜奖金；符合条件项目有机会获得种子资金、合作开发和其他投资渠道: Prizes for winners; eligible projects may access seed funding, joint development or other investment opportunities.
entries.传统 therapeutics company 本身；无 life-scienc: Therapeutics companies without life-science tools or diagnostic enabling technology; mature companies with little need for industry mentors.
entries.使用 Flagship application portal；500 Globa: Use the Flagship application portal; 500 Global discourages bypassing the formal process.

facts.On-site / Attendance: Four-month in-person Flagship program in Silicon Valley or the SF Bay Area.
facts.Visa / Relocation: International founders may apply, but US attendance requires lawful entry. The current Flagship page does not publish standard visa sponsorship.
facts.Application Materials: Official form covering team, product, market, traction, funding and incorporation. Investment due diligence follows selection.
facts.Public Contact Route: Use the Flagship application portal; 500 Global discourages bypassing the formal process.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Global pre-seed or seed technology teams with a product direction, seeking Silicon Valley go-to-market, product-market fit, fundraising and network support.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Teams unable to attend in Silicon Valley, non-technology or unscalable businesses, or companies beyond early-stage acceleration needs.
facts.Notes: A valuable Silicon Valley entry route for international founders. Terms are explicit, although 6% equity may be costly for companies with higher valuations or previous funding.

facts_raw.Funding / Support: US$40K funding for teams selected into the full accelerator; 10 startups receive an additional US$100K at the annual showcase
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: Stage 1: selected into pre-accelerator bootcamp; Stage 2: strongest teams selected into full accelerator receive $40K; Stage 3: 10 showcase winners receive additional $100K
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: Funding described as program funding/grant; no equity take published on current official FAQ
facts_raw.Company Required at Application: No rigid incorporation requirement published; startup/team with evidence of progress required

facts_raw.Can Apply Pre-Idea: No / evidence of startup progress required
facts_raw.Can Apply Solo: No — at least two founders required
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: At least two founders; evidence of startup progress (customer interviews, signed client interest, or other validation); full program commitment; at least one team member must attend all required accelerator activities; no simultaneous accelerator unless TAQADAM approves an exception; IP users must have written commercialization permission from university/company TTO.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: Strong complementary team, scalable business model, customer-focused founders, evidence of market validation, clear Saudi expansion strategy for international startups.
facts_raw.On-site Required: Yes / hybrid with mandatory in-person events
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: Six-month commitment. Official FAQ describes a bootcamp plus required in-person week/events at KAUST; most ongoing sessions are virtual/monthly. Attendance is mandatory for required activities.
facts_raw.Visa Support Level: Visa + flight support for required in-person program functions
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: No full-time relocation requirement published, but international startups must plan Saudi expansion within one year and attend required KAUST events. Program supports visas/flights for required in-person activities.
facts_raw.Deadline / Next Intake: Cohort 7 application deadline was extended to Jun 5, 2026; next cohort not yet published
facts_raw.Application Materials: Startup/team application covering team, scalability, market potential, progress/validation, Saudi expansion plan where relevant; later committee review and bootcamp selection.
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: Official site / register-interest form / public admissions email
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 高增长科技创业；阶段以 Early stage 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore: good for startups willing to build a real Saudi market-entry path. $40K is not paid just for initial bootcamp acceptance; it follows the second-stage selection into the full accelerator. The extra $100K is competitive follow-on funding for 10 showcase startups.
